column1: # Situations of the event influences: which event types belong to a situation and with which factor.
# The steps in event_influences.csv are multiplied by the factor of the event type and rounded.
# Event types without a line get a neutral rule (no change).
# 9 etwas ablegen oder umraeumen (drop, switch, set)
# 19 jemand bewegt sich wirklich nah (someone moves really close)
# 20 von einer Waffe getroffen werden (hit by a weapon)
# 22 jemand spricht in der Naehe (someone talks nearby)
# 23 jemand schreit in der Naehe (someone screams nearby)
# 25 sieht jemanden sich bewegen (sees someone move)
